title: betula pendula subsp. fontqueri
intro: Betula pendula subsp. fontqueri, commonly known as Silver Birch, is a subspecies of the birch tree native to the Iberian Peninsula. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Betula pendula subsp. fontqueri include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and diuretic properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of arthritis, gout, and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
